Definition: a criminal, or one accounted guilty
BiblicalUsage: A sinner is one accounted guilty, reckoned as an offender before God. The men of Sodom are sinners before the LORD exceedingly, Saul is sent to destroy the sinners the Amalekites, Isaiah warns that sinners will be destroyed together, and the censers of Korah's sinners are hammered into a covering for the altar.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Bible never softens the word sinner, and that is why grace is so startling. The censers of guilty men become the altar's covering, and judgement itself is turned into a sign.
RelatedEvents: Abram and Lot Part Ways; Anointing of Saul as King; Korah's Rebellion
